**Scope.** Review only artifact set in `V:\_TEMP_\saimail-T147-SAIFREN-folagh6g` for ticket T-147. No inference from other work, no reconstruction of absent history.

**Effort boundary.** Comparable to author-side build+test effort for T-147. Reviewer spends: evidence inventory, requirement-to-diff trace, targeted reads of changed source, run of existing verification, defect report. Does not add features, refactor, or write product tests to replace a missing one.

**Accept when.** Requirements demonstrably met by code at the stated path; verification (typecheck/tests/build) passes from a clean invocation; no correctness, security, or contract break visible in the diff; unrequested scope absent.

**Request changes when.** Missing or partial requirement; unrequested scope creep; failing or unrunnable verification; defect with a named failure path.

**Evidence unavailable when.** Artifact absent, unreadable, or referenced by evidence but not present. I report the gap and the claim it blocks. I do not guess, and I do not treat absence of evidence as failure of the work — only as unavailable evidence.

**Verdict deferred.** No accept/request/unavailable call until evidence reviewed. Standing by for artifact exposure.
